newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr-yr in May.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr-yr in May.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 1.5 percent year-on-year in May, the national statistics institute Istat said on Wednesday.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 76.7 (1988=100) in May, with month-on-month employment flat.
Hours worked per employee fell 0.7 percent year-on-year. Istat said the number of working days in the two periods was the same.
The number of people put on temporary lay-off schemes fell 11.2 percent year-on-year.
In the services sector, the employment index stood at 90.9 (1992=100), a fall of 1.8 percent year-on-year and a rise of 0.2 percent compared with April.
